original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 Cluster for SaaS Multi-Tenant Application'

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID where the database will be deployed

  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: List of subnet IDs for the DB subnet group (minimum 2 subnets in different AZs)

  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: saasdb
    Description: Name of the initial database
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
    MaxLength: 64

  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Description: Master username for the database
    AllowedPattern: '[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*'
    MaxLength: 16
    MinLength: 2

  MasterUserPassword:
    Type: String
    Description: Master password for the database
    NoEcho: true
    AllowedPattern: '^(?=.*[a-z])(?=.*[A-Z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[!@#$%^&*()_+=-]).{8,128}$'
    MaxLength: 128
    MinLength: 8

  MinACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    Description: Minimum Aurora Capacity Units (0.5 - 128)
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128

  MaxACU:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    Description: Maximum Aurora Capacity Units (0.5 - 128)
    MinValue: 0.5
    MaxValue: 128

  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    Description: Number of days to retain automated backups
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 35

  PreferredBackupWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: '03:00-04:00'
    Description: Daily time range for automated backups (UTC)
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]-[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'

  PreferredMaintenanceWindow:
    Type: String
    Default: 'sun:05:00-sun:06:00'
    Description: Weekly time range for system maintenance (UTC)
    AllowedPattern: '^(mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun):[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]-(mon|tue|wed|thu|fri|sat|sun):[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'

  DeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable deletion protection for the database cluster

Conditions:
  IsDeletionProtectionEnabled: !Equals [!Ref DeletionProtection, 'true']

Resources:
  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DBClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          CidrIp: 10.0.0.0/8
          Description: Allow PostgreSQL access from VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DBClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Parameter group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      Family: aurora-postgresql15
      Parameters:
        timezone: UTC
        log_statement: ddl
        log_min_duration_statement: 1000
        shared_preload_libraries: pg_stat_statements
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-param-group'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  DBCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '15.4'
      EngineMode: provisioned
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref MasterUserPassword
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DBClusterSecurityGroup
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref DBClusterParameterGroup
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod
      PreferredBackupWindow: !Ref PreferredBackupWindow
      PreferredMaintenanceWindow: !Ref PreferredMaintenanceWindow
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsDeletionProtectionEnabled, true, false]
      StorageEncrypted: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      EnableHttpEndpoint: false
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinACU
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxACU
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Application
          Value: 'SaaS-Multi-Tenant'

  DBInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref DBCluster
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      PromotionTier: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Application
          Value: 'SaaS-Multi-Tenant'

Outputs:
  DBClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Writer endpoint for the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-endpoint'

  DBClusterReadEndpoint:
    Description: Reader endpoint for the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-read-endpoint'

  DBClusterPort:
    Description: Database port
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.Endpoint.Port
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-port'

  DBClusterResourceId:
    Description: Resource ID of the Aurora cluster
    Value: !GetAtt DBCluster.DBClusterResourceId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-resource-id'

  DBClusterSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID for the cluster
    Value: !Ref DBClusterSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster-sg-id'
